qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Low-ticket, high-liability, regulation-mandated safety and medical devices (>60% gross margin) consistently pass through above-inflation price increases while maintaining ~20% EBIT margins.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Archetypal UK decentralized compounder in regulation-mandated safety, environmental, and medical niches with self-funded bolt-on M&A and minimal disruption risk. [5-10Y g: organic volume 4.5% + price 1.5% + self-funded bolt-on M&A 3.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Median GAAP ROIC of 13.62% with operating ROIC of 61.05%. FCF conversion exceeds 112% (FY2025 Owner FCF £392.4M vs Net Income £372.3M). 4-year Owner EPS compounded at 14.2% CAGR from £0.765 to £1.140. Net debt of £613.3M is easily covered by Owner Earnings (Net Debt / NI = 1.65x), and EBIT/Interest coverage is 15.1x. Exceptional capital allocation record with 45+ consecutive years of >=5% dividend growth.
